description: Connecting a social account CANNOT be done by you: it is an OAuth flow with a person clicking 'authorize' on the network's own screen. This tool returns a single-use link that expires in fifteen minutes — give it to the user and ask them to open it in their browser. Do not claim an account is connected until list_accounts shows it.

social_network.description: The network to connect. It travels inside the token, so the link only works for this one.

name: create_connect_link
title: Create an account connection link
